title: Heisenberg-limited calibration of entangling gates with robust phase estimation
authors: Kenneth Rudinger; J. P. Marceaux; Akel Hashim; David I. Santiago; Irfan Siddiqi; Kevin C. Young
notes: [abstract only] RPE estimates coherent errors in multi-qubit gates; experimental CZ calibration and GST comparison. Does not by abstract establish decision-relevant certification.

title: Robust Calibration of a Universal Single-Qubit Gate-Set via Robust Phase Estimation
authors: Shelby Kimmel; Guang Hao Low; Theodore J. Yoder
notes: [abstract only] Provably robust and Heisenberg-scaling estimation of selected systematic single-qubit gate errors.

title: Experimental demonstration of cheap and accurate phase estimation
authors: Kenneth Rudinger; Shelby Kimmel; Daniel Lobser; Peter Maunz
notes: [abstract only] Experimental RPE on trapped-ion X/Y rotations; reports SPAM robustness and comparison with GST.

title: Consistency testing for robust phase estimation
authors: Antonio E. Russo; William M. Kirby; Kenneth M. Rudinger; Andrew D. Baczewski; Shelby Kimmel
notes: [abstract only] Consistency checks can identify RPE regimes where robustness thresholds fail; relevant to prespecified k-linearity diagnostics.

title: Fractional gates
notes: [literature] Official workflow and angle-constraint documentation; current page says out-of-range RZZ angles may be transformed by FoldRzzAngle. Accessed 2026-11-27.

title: Quantum kernels with fractional gates
notes: [literature] Official tutorial states fractional gates are unsupported with dynamic circuits, Pauli twirling, PEC, and ZNE/PEA; documents RZZ angle constraints and FoldRzzAngle behavior. Accessed 2026-11-27.

title: View backend details
notes: [literature] Current documentation describes Heron RZZ error as averaged over RZZ angles using a variant of RB for arbitrary unitaries. This contradicts the v0/v1 note that the displayed value is copied from a non-fractional gate. Accessed 2026-11-27.

title: Sound and Efficient Certification of High-Quality Qubit Operations: Theory and Experiment
authors: Nikolai Miklin; Jan Noller; Jose Martinez; Lucas B. Vieira; Ulrich Poschinger; Ferdinand Schmidt-Kaler; Mariami Gachechiladze
notes: [literature] Relevant sections and theorem appendices reviewed; finite-sample SPAM-robust single-qubit spectral/fidelity certification narrows C2/C3 but does not use a downstream decision tolerance. See notes/MIKLIN2026.md.

title: Classical certification of quantum gates under the dimension assumption
authors: Jan Noller; Nikolai Miklin; Martin Kliesch; Mariami Gachechiladze
notes: [literature] Protocol, single-qubit results, sample-complexity argument, conclusion and theorem structure reviewed. Sound dimension-assumption certification is fidelity-based, not downstream-decision based. See notes/NOLLER2024.md.

title: Efficient Experimental Verification of Quantum Gates with Local Operations
authors: Rui-Qi Zhang; Zhibo Hou; Jun-Feng Tang; Jiangwei Shang; Huangjun Zhu; Guo-Yong Xiang; Chuan-Feng Li; Guang-Can Guo
notes: [abstract only] Experimental local-operation verification of CNOT and Toffoli gates with fidelity lower bounds at stated confidence; directly relevant to finite-sample gate verification costs.

title: Application-Oriented Performance Benchmarks for Quantum Computing
authors: Thomas Lubinski; Sonika Johri; Paul Varosy; Jeremiah Coleman; Luning Zhao; Jason Necaise; Charles H. Baldwin; Karl Mayer; Timothy Proctor
notes: [literature] Benchmark definition, execution, metrics, limitations and conclusions reviewed. Establishes application-oriented benchmarking prior art but not a decision-specific finite-sample equivalence certificate. See notes/LUBINSKI2021.md.

title: Randomized Benchmarking with Confidence
authors: Joel J. Wallman; Christopher Granade; Robin Harper; Steven T. Flammia
notes: [abstract only] Develops rigorous confidence intervals for randomized benchmarking under finite sequence sampling; full assumptions and relevance to fixed-shot certification pending.

title: Multi-qubit Randomized Benchmarking Using Few Samples
authors: Jonas Helsen; Joel J. Wallman; Steven T. Flammia; Stephanie Wehner
notes: [abstract only] Bounds the number of random sequences needed for rigorous multi-qubit RB confidence intervals and discusses misleading ordinary least-squares fits.

title: Minimum quantum run-time characterization and calibration via restless measurements with dynamic repetition rates
authors: Caroline Tornow; Naoki Kanazawa; William E. Shanks; Daniel J. Egger
notes: [abstract only] IBM-led study of faster characterization and calibration, including error-amplifying gate sequences; relevant as calibration practice rather than decision-specific certification.

title: Quantum sequential parameter testing
authors: Simon Morelli; Ricard Ravell Rodriguez; John Calsamiglia; Ramon Munoz-Tapia; Gael Sentis; Michalis Skotiniotis
notes: [abstract only] Tests a continuous quantum parameter up to a prescribed tolerance with controlled error and variable sample size; a high-priority comparator for Ch4 equivalence-style positioning, although Ch4 currently fixes the budget.

title: Identity check problem for shallow quantum circuits
authors: Sergey Bravyi; Natalie Parham; Minh Tran
notes: [abstract only] Classical approximation of diamond- and operator-norm distance to identity for restricted shallow circuits; relevant to operational tolerance but not an experimental finite-shot certificate.

title: Statistical analysis of randomized benchmarking
authors: Robin Harper; Ian Hincks; Chris Ferrie; Steven T. Flammia; Joel J. Wallman
notes: [abstract only] Finite-data RB design and analysis with nuisance elimination, multiplicative precision, and credible regions; relevant comparator for estimation cost and heteroscedastic fitting.

title: Training Saturation in Layerwise Quantum Approximate Optimisation
authors: E. Campos; D. Rabinovich; V. Akshay; J. Biamonte
notes: [abstract only] Studies layerwise QAOA training saturation and coherent dephasing numerically; retained for full-text screening but does not by abstract address fixed-instance decision certification.
